family: scale-out quote-harvest (net-replacement entry + break-even + two-leg partial exit)
note: NEW instrument. V1-V4 stay frozen and untouched. Scale-out MOTIVATED by a gap diagnostic + partial-exit backtest on burned data; params are round a-priori numbers, adjudicated only by fresh forward data + the promotion gate. PAPER: no orders/wallet/SOL/on-chain, free data only.

sizing.model: forward arms at V1-comparable fraction; staged $10+$10 / 20%-settled capacity-capped is the intended LIVE sizing, gated on V5 proving positive

kill_switch.rule: HALT if, after n>=N_min resolved PASS trades, upper95(log-growth g) < 0 OR dump_rate >= dump_rate_max

ecr_stress_policy.leg_note: two legs charge the pinned per-side execution model on each leg; scale-out never exceeds max_exit_legs

promotion_criteria: positive log-growth after ALL costs (curve fees, ATA rent, real-size slippage, failed-landing fees, BOTH legs)
positive per UTC day AND per creator-cluster
not carried by a single >=7x winner (drop-the-max robust)
unexitable rate under the B20B baseline
survives a fresh hash-frozen confirmation period never seen

benchmarks.score: pot growth G = sum ln(1 + position_fraction * stressed_net_return); dump-rate is a hard kill-gate, not the score
benchmarks.null: control = a material cluster sell fired but NET replacement was NOT confirmed; scored identically -> G_control
benchmarks.honest_prior: ~0 or small-positive; the loss mode is gaps after going green; scale-out banks a gap-proof gain on part while riding the rest for the fat tail
